recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中一個緻密的小淋巴球聚集沿著骨小樑表面貼附生長（paratrabecular aggregate），周圍骨髓其餘部分多為出血與稀疏細胞；緊貼骨小樑的淋巴球聚集是濾泡性淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓的特徵分布。
features: Dense aggregate of small dark lymphoid cells hugging and molding along the surface of a bony trabecula (paratrabecular pattern)
Aggregate composed of monotonous small cells with round to irregular hyperchromatic nuclei at low power
Few interspersed fat spaces within the aggregate
Remaining intertrabecular space largely hemorrhagic with sparse hematopoietic cells
Cytologic detail (nuclear clefts) not resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a bone marrow trephine shows a dense, well-circumscribed aggregate of small lymphoid cells applied along the surface of a bony trabecula in a paratrabecular distribution. The remaining intertrabecular spaces are largely hemorrhagic with sparse hematopoiesis, which limits assessment of cellularity. Nuclear detail cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by follicular lymphoma; CD20, CD10, BCL6 and BCL2 immunostains are recommended to confirm and to distinguish from a benign lymphoid aggregate.

ddx.vs: Reactive aggregates are small, well circumscribed and located in the intertrabecular space away from bone, with a mixed T- and B-cell composition.
Mantle cell lymphoma involves marrow in nodular, interstitial or paratrabecular patterns but is CD5+ and cyclin D1+.
CLL/SLL forms non-paratrabecular nodular or interstitial infiltrates with proliferation centers and is CD5+ CD23+ LEF1+.
SMZL typically shows nodular and intrasinusoidal involvement highlighted by CD20 in sinusoids, and is CD10 negative.
